```{r} 
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(dlookr)
library(reshape2)
library(ggstatsplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
```


## patient data###
```{r}
patientidentifier <- read_excel("E:/Daten(x)/Daten(lw-r)/Abc/Doktorarbeit SJS/Analyse R-Statistics/gender plots - bmi/gender_info_full.xlsx",
           sheet = 1, skip = 1 ) %>% 
#  filter(Treatment.x == "Leber_Diclo") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = 3:4,
               names_to = "gender",
               values_to = "numberofpatient") %>% 
  filter(numberofpatient== 1)
patientidentifier
```

### gpt ########################################################################

```{r}
gpt_gender_full <- left_join(patientidentifier, gpt_full, by = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2") %>%
  select(1,2,3,6,7) %>%
  drop_na(labreads) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(attribute, "_From Start|_From start|_DBS")) 
gpt_gender_full
```


```{r}
gpt_gender_full_m <- gpt_gender_full %>%
    filter(gender == "Male") 

# Step 1: Prepare your data
gpt_gender_full_m_prepared <- gpt_gender_full_m %>% 
  mutate(
    Treatment.x = as.factor(Treatment.x),
    `Edited_BfArM Nummer2` = as.factor(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`)
  )

# Step 2: Filter only Treatment.xs with "Leber" and count unique patients per group
group_counts <- gpt_gender_full_m_prepared %>%
  filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment.x)) %>% 
  group_by(Treatment.x) %>%
  summarise(total_unique = n_distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`), .groups = "drop")

# Step 3: Calculate maximum labreads value per group (for positioning labels above the boxes)
y_pos <- gpt_gender_full_m_prepared %>%
  filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment.x)) %>%
  group_by(Treatment.x) %>%
  summarise(y = max(labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05, .groups = "drop")

# Step 4: Join counts and y-positions into one dataframe
group_counts <- left_join(group_counts, y_pos, by = "Treatment.x")

# Step 5: Create the base plot (can use all data or filtered data)
liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups_m <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = gpt_gender_full_m_prepared %>% filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment.x)),  # plot only Leber Treatment.xs
  x = Treatment.x,
  y = labreads,
  type = "np",
  title = "liver_gpt_full_comparison of ALT between NSAID-groups for male", # ALT for labvalue and daily dose",
       xlab = "NSAID intake",
       ylab = "GPT (U/L)", 
)

# Step 6: Add count labels to the plot
liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups_m <- liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups_m + 
  geom_text(
    data = group_counts,
    aes(
      x = Treatment.x,
      y = y,
      label = paste0("N = ", total_unique)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4,
    vjust = -0.5
  )
liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups_m

dir.create("plots_gender", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_gender/liver_gpt_full_comparison of nsaid groups for male.svg", height = 8, width = 6.5)
print(liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups_m)
dev.off()
```
